caveats.bike: bike counts anchor APPROACH-LEVEL edgeData only (TMC bikes carry no turn resolution) — coarser than vehicle turn calibration
caveats.ped: ped counts are intersection CROSSINGS; they anchor a corridor-total walk scale, order-of-magnitude only — NO GEH claim for bike/ped

tool_cmdlines: python.exe randomTrips.py -n corridor.net.xml -o cand.car.trips.xml -r cand.car.rou.xml -b 0 -e 7200 -p 0.5 --fringe-factor 10.0 --min-distance 300 --validate --edge-permission passenger --random-routing-factor 1.5 --seed 42 --prefix c

python.exe randomTrips.py -n corridor.net.xml -o cand.bike.trips.xml -r cand.bike.rou.xml -b 0 -e 7200 -p 4 --fringe-factor 3 --min-distance 200 --max-distance 4000 --validate --vehicle-class bicycle --edge-permission bicycle --seed 42 --prefix cb

python.exe routeSampler.py -r cand.car.rou.xml -t turn_counts.am.xml -o calibrated.am.rou.xml --prefix veh --geh-ok 5 --turn-max-gap 2 --optimize full --seed 42 --mismatch-output mismatch.car.xml --attributes type="passenger" departLane="best"

python.exe routeSampler.py -r cand.bike.rou.xml -d bike_edgedata.am.xml -o calibrated.am.bike.rou.xml --prefix bike --geh-ok 5 --seed 42 --mismatch-output mismatch.bike.xml --attributes type="bike_bicycle"
python.exe randomTrips.py -n corridor.net.xml -o cand.ped.trips.xml -r calibrated.am.ped.rou.xml -b 0 -e 7200 -p 1.4182 --pedestrians --prefix ped --min-distance 50 --max-distance 1500 --seed 42

iterations.note: iteration 0: as-built demand, probe baseline (57608/67808 inserted, 5154 teleports)
iteration 2: hourly count aggregation + direct candidates -p 0.35 + time-to-teleport 600
iteration 3 (ACCEPTED): revert to iteration-0 recipe — 15-min counts, -p 0.5 fringe 10, ttt 300; best of 3 iteration families

iteration_verdict: ACCEPTED = the iteration-0 recipe (15-min interval turn counts, randomTrips -p 0.5 --fringe-factor 10, routeSampler --optimize full --turn-max-gap 2, time-to-teleport 300): GEH<5 at 51.8% of 421 counted approach links on 2h mean-hourly flows — BELOW the 85% DMRB-style target. Three iteration families were tried: candidate density/variety/origin-spread (it1: 35.1% — windier routes deepen saturation), hourly count aggregation + higher teleport threshold (it2: 42.5% — more demand placed, worse gridlock), and the accepted baseline recipe (51.8%, deterministic across rebuilds). The binding constraint is STRUCTURAL: the corridor net is bbox-clipped (boundary intersections lost legs; 15% of loaded vehicles never insert; ~9% teleport under saturation) and carries netconvert-default signal plans, not the city's coordinated timings — the network as modeled cannot carry the full counted volumes. Treat absolute calibrated volumes as approximate; baseline-vs-scenario comparisons remain like-for-like. Bbox expansion / signal-plan import are the V2.1c-scale levers.
